title: Small obstruction, refrigeration unit damaged on a fresh-goods wagon
_comment: The case file ties everything together and decides which federations take part. One more customer is one more entry in 'federations' -- nothing in the code changes.

measurements._comment: Telemetry of the affected wagons. Belongs to record type 'incident'. Can move into s1_incident.json later, once the data track adds telematics.

truth._status: PROPOSAL from the engine track -- data specialist, please confirm or correct
truth.why: Unit running rough, but the goods are still within their window (yellow). Customer has 4.5 days of stock (green) and routine urgency, contract penalty below the threshold. Cooling is enough; transshipment would be expensive and unnecessary.
truth._teaches: The traffic light on stock prevents an expensive measure. The assessor never learns that it is 4.5 days.
